answer.rationale: Contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew, so deferral is not viable. A full vendor switch (memory_c2) promises sharp unit-cost cuts toward the 18% mandate, but with the line at 94% of committed volume and zero buffer, any onboarding slip or invoicing error is a direct delivery risk — so I want to verify the actual archived record of that switch before relying on it. memory_c4 suggests benchmarking at renewal moved the incumbent on both price and payment terms, which could capture much of the mandated savings without migration risk; verifying it tests whether that lever is real. My intent is to renegotiate with the incumbent using market benchmarks and multi-year volume commitment (memory_c6) to approach the 18% target while preserving the stable integration (memory_c1), keeping the verified switch option as a BATNA. Confidence is provisional pending archive results.
